High_End_Systems@Dataflash_5000@v0.13.gd._notes: ETC datasheet (High End Systems is an ETC brand; highend.com redirects to etcconnect.com). 1000 W total LED power / wattage. Weight with reflector dome. 60 deg with reflector dome, 120 deg with EC dome.

High_End_Systems@GigaPix@v_1.00.gdtf._notes: Noise standard mode 39.4 dBA (studio 30.3). Peak cd narrow beam 4.5 deg.

High_End_Systems@Lonestar@v1.6.5.gdtf._notes: Ultra-Bright engine (290 W LED). Noise 35 dBA at full intensity (stationary). Native 7000K, variable down to 2200K.

High_End_Systems@MegaPix@v_1.00.gdtf._notes: Noise standard mode 36.9 dBA. Peak cd narrow beam 4.5 deg.

High_End_Systems@SolaPix_Fan_8@v1.2.gdtf._notes: Wattage standard/max/standby 366/413/26 W. Peak 66,100 cd at narrow 4.5 deg (7,104 lx @10 ft) - fan array so center intensity is roughly one cell; current record 920,000 cd differs strongly. Infinite pan (no pan range stated). Field lumens 5,800, sphere 6,400.

High_End_Systems@Zeo@v1.2.4.gdtf._notes: Wattage 1,670 W (4 x 300 W RGBW COB, 1,200 W LED) - current record 240 W is far off. Light concentration 13-55 deg. No candela in datasheet.
